commit: fix: line breaks in multiline strings

truth.description: printString in src/common/util.js now returns a doc array instead of a string, but the CSS printer still passes it as the callback of String.replace in adjustStrings, which coerces the doc to text, so a CSS attribute selector whose quoted value continues onto a second line after a backslash is printed with [object Object] in place of the line break.

distractions.why: A TypeScript string literal type takes the fluid assignment layout rather than the break-after-operator layout that shouldBreakAfterOperator forces for a Flow StringLiteralTypeAnnotation, so the string stays after the equals sign and only its first line has to fit.
